finding.portable_diagnostic_defect: The raw Chrome --dump-dom files were copied into the artifact as if they were portable visual diagnostics. Reopening them re-executes the preserved harness script, and a forced-colors DOM dump does not preserve the forced-colors rendering state when reopened in an ordinary browser. They are machine-capture transport, not visual evidence.
finding.reflow_visibility_defect: In the normal Chrome capture every REFLOW_320 panel measured 657.203125 CSS px high at top 72, yielding a 729.203125 CSS px panel bottom inside a 720 CSS px frame. The frame used overflow:hidden, so the lower approximately 9.2 CSS px of the panel carrier was clipped. The verifier checked horizontal reflow only and therefore missed this common carrier defect.
finding.family_specificity: Neither defect is family-specific. All six controls/families share the same carrier geometry and transport path. No color result is admitted from the invalidated run.

correction.geometry: Retain the already-frozen 720 CSS px frame height, 72 CSS px panel top, all panel widths, padding, typography, spacing, radii and element order. No frozen geometry value changes.
correction.reflow_visibility: For REFLOW_320 only, preserve horizontal containment with overflow-x:hidden and make vertical overflow visible instead of clipped. This changes clipping behavior, not the frozen dimensions or candidate geometry.
correction.diagnostics: Keep raw dump-dom HTML only as ephemeral verifier input. Publish parsed diagnostic JSON plus actual PNG captures from normal and forced-colors browser executions. Do not label raw DOM dumps as portable visual snapshots.
correction.verification: The verifier must record frame overflow policy and panel bottom geometry, reject any 320 cell whose vertical overflow is clipped, and continue enforcing the frozen horizontal-overflow, contrast, focus, forced-colors and isolation floors.

integrity.reason: The previous mechanical-clean claim and Design Sol subjective view depended on an artifact/carrier presentation that was not fully valid. Both must be re-derived from the corrected packet before Director adjudication.

non_authority: This correction creates no production color, spacing, typography, theme, component, Windows accessibility, final identity or Phase-C authority.
